item.title: Apple's Sci-Fi Thriller Masterpiece Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History
item.description: In 2022, Apple was three years into its streaming experiment and still trying to find its footing. Aside from Ted Lasso , the tech giant hadn't released any breakout hits. And while a few sci-fi shows like For All Mankind and Foundation had fans, they weren't exactly mainstream success stories. Then everything changed when Apple took a bet on an unknown showrunner (with backing from an A-list actor) to create something revolutionary.

item.title: 20 Years Ago, the Best Sci-Fi Show of the Century Delivered the Most Epic Space Battle in TV History
item.description: Two decades later, this spectacle from Battlestar Galactica season 3’s “Exodus, Part 2” remains unforgettable sci-fi TV. It’s dazzling and horrifying, and still one of the coolest things ever broadcast on science-fiction television. From a tactical standpoint, the “Adama Maneuver” is absolutely bonkers and one of the riskiest spaceship tactics, perhaps ever (sorry, Vice-Admiral Holdo). What if the ship had gotten torn apart from ripping through the atmosphere? What if the FTL drive malfunctioned or didn’t activate in time? Somehow, it’s also not even the most visually impressive sequence in the episode.

item.title: Zelda Fans Who Loved Ocarina of Time Need to Play This Game Next
item.description: By now, you’ve probably had time to play The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake on the Nintendo Switch 2. You’ve marveled at what a great job it does of bringing the classic Nintendo 64 adventure to a new generation, with visual improvements and quality-of-life changes to make it more palatable for that new audience. Maybe you’ve even run through it a second time.

item.title: Pokémon Go Wild Area 2026 event schedule, habitat spawns, and bonuses
item.description: Pokémon Go 's big global Wild Area 2026 event is finally here, running on Nov. 14 and 15 from 10 a.m. until 6 p.m. in your local time . This event features the debut of Gigantamax Duraludon , as well as Dynamax Dialga and Palkia . Safari Balls and mighty Pokémon also make a return from the previous years' Wild Area events, which means you can find some powerful Pokémon roaming about.

item.title: How to get mighty Pokémon in Pokémon Go
item.description: Special "mighty" Pokémon appear during the Wild Area event. We explain what they are, their special moves, and a mighty Pokémon list to target.

item.title: How to get Go Safari Balls in Pokémon Go
item.description: You can get Go Safari Balls as part of Pokémon Go Wild Area events, and can only be used during event hours. No, seriously — they disappear after the event ends.

item.title: 25 Years Later, Frodo’s Best Lord of the Ring Quote Proves He's the Ultimate Fantasy Hero
item.description: An inherent tragedy follows every character in The Lord of the Rings , which isn’t surprising, given that Peter Jackson’s epic fantasy trilogy is adapted from the works of J.R.R. Tolkien. The author has never been shy about exploring grim topics, and in a 1968 interview with the BBC , Tolkien said that all stories are about one thing: death.

item.title: 20 Years Later, A Classic Nintendo DS Puzzle Game Officially Returns
item.description: Next year will mark the 20th anniversary of Level-5's beloved Professor Layton series. To celebrate, the company has announced it is remaking Professor Layton and the Curious Village .

item.title: HBO’s 5-Part Crime Drama Has One of the Best Seasons in TV History
item.description: At the turn of the 21st century, HBO was the place for prestige crime drama. The launch of The Sopranos in 1999 paved the way for the 2002 premiere of The Wire , which focused on drug dealers in Baltimore and the police officers trying to disrupt their operations. The series is still one of the best shows of all time, and provided breakout roles for huge stars like Idris Elba and Michael B. Jordan . But while it was compelling from the beginning, The Wire truly achieved perfection in season 4 when the scope expanded beyond the drug trade to examine the cycle of institutional failure.

item.title: Fallout 5 and Fallout Remasters Officially Announced
item.description: Xbox wants more Fallout, and after a yearslong drought of new games, Bethesda Softworks is making it happen. Bethesda plans to release remasters of both Fallout 3 and Fallout: New Vegas for modern platforms, the company said in July in a massive roadmap of the developer's future. Those remasters are part of a larger plan to reinvest in Fallout games — including Fallout 5 , which is currently in pre-production — and a new untitled project at Obsidian Entertainment.
